# Callouts: Recovery 3.3 - power on: the current and the 3.3 V rail

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec3-3_power-on.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec3-3_power-on.jpg)

Supply on with the limit at 100 mA. Read the supply's current, then 3.3 V at U15 pin 8 against GND. If the rail reads 0 V, measure U17's input (C577 side) and output (C579 side).

| 2 | JP5.2 | JP5 pin 2, GND |  | Power | confirmed | The round pad above pin 1, '2' printed left of it; GND, the same net as U15 pin 4. |
